Session.description: Who is calling, and what they may do.

ErrorBody.description: The error body of the OpenAPI document.

extraction.description: Whether pages can be read: the operator set the model's address, and a model is named.

problems.description: What keeps the aggregator from doing its work, in sentences.

next_run_at.description: The next scheduled start. Absent while the jobs are switched off.

run_requested.description: A run was asked for and has not started yet.

JobView.description: One of the scraper's jobs as the console shows it.

trigger.description:
`schedule`, `manual`, `page` (a page was confirmed or asked to be checked) or `retry` (the
run before was left open).

ok.description: Absent while the run is in progress.

covers.description: What the run covers, by id: the pages of a check, the vendors of a scan.

last_seen_at.description: When a scraper last asked for work.

present.description: Whether one asked in the last five minutes.

ScraperView.description: Whether a scraper runs, as far as the server can tell: it asks for work every half minute.

BrowserView.description: The browser the scraper renders pages in, as the scraper last reported it.

next_cursor.description: Where the next page starts. Absent on the last page.

api_id_confirmed.description: Whether a vendor's own page states the id.

checked_at.description: When its source last stated the price.

ModelSummary.description: A model in a list: what the console's table shows.

api_id_confirmed.description: Whether a vendor's own page states the id.

checked_at.description: When its source last stated the price.

entry.description: The model as the catalogue publishes it (`pacod.catalog/v1`).

prices.description: Every version of its price, newest first.

ModelDetail.description: A model with everything known about it.

price.description: The catalogue's price, without its dates.

checked_at.description: When its source last stated it.

superseded_at.description: When the next version replaced it. Absent for the price in effect.

Change.description: One entry of the log of what changed.

sites.description: Where the weekly scan starts for a vendor with no page there yet.

enabled.description: A vendor switched off is not read, and not published.

complete.description: An administrator's word that its pages list all of its models.

read_complete.description:
Whether every active page was read without failure at the last check. The catalogue says
a vendor is complete only then.

Vendor.description: A company whose API serves models.

VendorInput.description: A vendor as an administrator adds or changes it.

url.description: Normalised: no fragment, no tracking parameters, no slash at the end.

kind.description: `page` (rendered in a browser and read by a model) or `feed` (a list, read without either).

priority.description: Where two pages of a vendor say different things about a model, the lower number wins.

title.description: The page's title, as the scan saw it.

score.description: How strongly the scan judged the page to list models and prices.

moved_from.description: The page this one replaces, where the scan found that a page moved here.

state.description: What the last check found. Absent before the page was first checked.

PageView.description: A page with its vendor's name and what the last check found.

last_ok_at.description: When the page last answered and read as it should.

last_changed_at.description: When the page last read differently from the time before.

last_read_at.description: When the extraction model last read it.

final_url.description: Where the page ended up after redirects, when that is elsewhere.

outcome.description: `read`, `unchanged`, `not_read` or `failed`; empty before the first check.

flag.description: `gone` or `moved`, when the scan found so.

check_requested.description: A check was asked for and has not happened yet.

PageState.description: What the last check found out about a page.

PageInput.description:
A page as an administrator adds or changes it. Its status changes through confirm and dismiss;
what the scan saw about it stays as the scan saw it.

enabled.description: Whether the check and the scan run on their schedules.

schedule.description:
When the confirmed pages are checked. A cron expression with five fields, as standard cron
reads it: days of the week from 0 (Sunday) to 7 (Sunday again) or by name. It may restrict
the day of the month or the day of the week, not both.

scan_schedule.description: When the vendors' sites are scanned for pages, in the same form. Weekly by default.

time_zone.description: The IANA time zone the schedules are read in.

mode.description:
How the extraction model is reached. Empty: gateway where only `AGG_GW_URL` is set, otherwise
standalone. There is no falling back from one to the other: a mode without its endpoint waits.

extraction_model.description:
The model that reads the pages in standalone mode, by the name its endpoint takes: a chat
model with structured output. Empty: the operator's `AGG_LLM_MODEL`. Pages are not read until
one of the two names a model.

gateway_model.description:
The model that reads the pages in gateway mode, by the name the gateway takes. The names
differ, which is why a switch of the mode needs no change here. Empty: the operator's
`AGG_GW_MODEL`.

extraction_context_window.description: How much the extraction model takes in at once, for the size of the parts of a long page.

max_extractions_per_run.description: How many calls of the extraction model one run may make. A long page takes several.

openrouter_price_vendors.description:
The vendors whose prices are taken from OpenRouter's list. For others, open-weight models
in particular, its price is usually a third party's. Its properties apply for every vendor.

extraction_model_default.description:
The operator's `AGG_LLM_MODEL`, used in standalone mode while `extraction_model` is empty.
It is set in the environment and cannot be changed here.

gateway_model_default.description:
The operator's `AGG_GW_MODEL`, used in gateway mode while `gateway_model` is empty. It is set
in the environment and cannot be changed here.

standalone_configured.description: Whether the environment names an endpoint for standalone mode (`AGG_LLM_URL`).

gateway_configured.description: Whether the environment names an endpoint for gateway mode (`AGG_GW_URL`).

SettingsView.description:
The settings, and the version to send back with a change. It says whether each mode has an
endpoint and never what it is: this is shown to anyone who may read the console.

oneOf.description: The aggregator calls a provider's endpoint itself (`AGG_LLM_URL`).
The aggregator calls through a pacod-gw (`AGG_GW_URL`), which accounts each call.

Mode.description:
How the extraction model is reached. This is not `docker-compose.standalone.yml`, which is about
where the shared components come from: either mode runs on either stack.

max_pages_per_vendor.description: How many candidate pages per vendor the scan opens in the browser and scores.

min_score.description:
The score a page needs to be proposed. A price per million tokens counts 2, a model the
catalogue knows 3, a keyword in the address or title 4.

keywords.description: Words in an address or title that make a page worth opening.

ScanSettings.description: How the weekly scan looks for pages.
